definitions.explanation: A historical establishment where {遊女|ゆうじょ} (courtesans) lived and entertained customers, typical of the pleasure quarters of the Edo period. A dated word tied to that era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遊女屋|ゆうじょや}。
examples.english: A brothel of the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遊女屋|ゆうじょや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{並|なら}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Brothels stood in a row along the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遊女屋|ゆうじょや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{一角|いっかく}→一角：11231_ikkaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The town once had a quarter where many brothels were gathered.

notes:
A historical house of courtesans, found in the licensed pleasure quarters of the Edo period. A dated word, encountered mainly in history and period fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊女屋|ゆうじょや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ: brothels line up
- {遊女屋|ゆうじょや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to frequent a brothel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遊郭|ゆうかく}→遊郭：15373_yuukaku⟧: a licensed pleasure quarter — the walled district containing many such houses
